02What the split means

I

The process is real

A session runs an agent tool inside a server-hosted PTY. The terminal is the execution surface; the teammate is the durable persona behind it.

II

The socket carries bytes

Binary WebSocket frames carry raw PTY output. Small text frames carry control such as attached, size, and exit.

III

The browser paints them

The viewer decodes the byte stream, preserves split UTF-8 characters, and advances a raw offset so reconnects can request only what they missed.

capture checked 2026-08-20 Capture note. The command and stdout characters come from this live work session’s tm8 CLI journal. This teaching replay cuts that captured text at line boundaries so you can scrub it; real WebSocket frames may break at different byte boundaries. Their order and payload still drive one terminal stream. PTY output is held in a bounded replay buffer for reconnects; it is not written into the graph event stream.
